name: monad-tools
description: Monad language support: a language server (diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, document and workspace symbols) from the self-hosted `monad lsp`, plus MCP tools — check, symbols, hover, definition, organize_imports, all workspace-aware across dependency motes — from `monad-rs mcp`. Both binaries are built from this repo; see the README for which build each needs.
